overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter of dehydrated Safed Musli Powder from India. We source raw roots directly through an established agricultural network. Our facility utilizes a strict six-step process, including cleaning, sorting, controlled drying, grinding, sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch. This ensures uniform 80 to 100 mesh particle size and moisture content below seven percent for industrial buyers.

We supply bulk Safed Musli Powder to international distributors, formulation manufacturers, and brand owners. Our operations support OEM and private label needs with flexible packaging formats. With an MOQ of 5 Kg, we provide export documentation support and custom mesh sizes upon request. Every production batch maintains a stable twenty-four month shelf life when stored in cool, dry conditions.
highlights: Uniform particle size of 80 to 100 mesh
Fine botanical powder with neutral profile

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Safed Musli Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, supporting both initial product development and large-scale commercial procurement.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide complete OEM and private label services, including retail pouches, jars, and customized bulk packaging.

faqs.q: Can the mesh size be customized for our formulation lines?
faqs.a: Yes. We can adjust milling parameters to supply custom mesh sizes upon request to fit your processing equipment.

faqs.q: What is the standard shelf life and recommended storage?
faqs.a: The powder has a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Can we obtain product samples before bulk purchasing?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide product samples on request to facilitate technical evaluation and quality assessment.

faqs.q: What export documentation support do you offer?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide comprehensive export documentation support and certificates of analysis with every shipment.
